name: John Hadl
achievements: NFL leader in passing yards and touchdowns, 1971
blurb: Hadl wore #21 for nearly his entire pro career, leading the NFL in passing yards and touchdowns in 1971 and anchoring the Chargers offense for over a decade.

name: Jim Kiick
achievements: Member of the undefeated 1972 Miami Dolphins
Scored the go-ahead touchdown in Super Bowl VII
blurb: One half of Miami's ‘Butch and Sundance’ backfield, Kiick wore #21 during the Dolphins' perfect 1972 season and scored in back-to-back Super Bowl wins.

name: LaDainian Tomlinson
achievements: NFL single-season rushing touchdown record (28, in 2006)
blurb: ‘LT’ is one of the greatest running backs the game has seen, wearing #21 while setting the NFL's single-season touchdown record and winning league MVP in 2006.

name: Tim Duncan
blurb: Known as ‘The Big Fundamental,’ Duncan spent his entire 19-year Hall of Fame career in #21 with the Spurs — born and raised in Saint Croix, U.S. Virgin Islands.

name: Dominique Wilkins
blurb: The ‘Human Highlight Film’ made #21 iconic in Atlanta — a nine-time All-Star and electrifying dunker who wore it before Tim Duncan ever put it on in San Antonio.

name: Luis Rengifo
achievements: AL Player of the Week, September 2023
Switch hitter known for defensive versatility
Signed with San Diego in 2026, wearing #21
blurb: A switch-hitting Venezuelan infielder/outfielder, Rengifo wears #21 for the Padres — proof that #21 stories aren't only about the legends already in Cooperstown.

name: Cam Lampkin
achievements: Led Washington State in pass breakups as a senior
Started all 12 games in his final college season
blurb: An undrafted free agent out of Washington State who worked his way onto the Rams' roster, Lampkin wears #21 in the defensive backfield.

name: Han Xu
achievements: 2023 FIBA Women's Asia Cup Tournament MVP
blurb: At 6'11", Han Xu wears #21 for the New York Liberty and is one of Chinese basketball's most decorated exports, with multiple MVP awards on the international stage.
